name: 6T

Platform.Operating system: OxygenOS (based on Android Pie, upgradable to Android 11)

Display.Display: 6.41 in 1080p (2340 ×1080 pixels) Full-HD+ Optic AMOLED / DCI-P3 (402 ppi) with 19.5:9 aspect ratio

Cameras.Rear camera: 16 MP Sony Exmor IMX519 (f/1.7, OIS + EIS) + 20 MP Sony Exmor IMX376K (f/1.7), phase detection autofocus, dual-LED flash, Video 4K at 30 or 60fps, 1080p at 30, 60 or 240 fps, 720p at 30 or 480 fps
Cameras.Front camera: 16 MP Sony Exmor IMX371 (f/2.0, EIS, HDR), Video 1080p at 30 fps, 720p at 30 fps

Battery.Battery: 3700 mAh Li-Ion with Dash Charge technology

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3G, 4G VoLTE, Bluetooth 5.0 with aptX, NFC, 2x2 MIMO WiFi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and Galileo, USB-C
